tools.name: list_reason_codes
tools.description: List the 9 card-network chargeback reason codes covered by ChargeGuard (Visa, Mastercard, Amex) with one-line summaries. Use first when the user mentions a chargeback without a code.

tools.name: lookup_reason_code
tools.description: Look up one card-network chargeback reason code: what it means, the evidence that wins the representment, the response window, and the full guide URL. Accepts the code (e.g. '13.2') or a slug fragment (e.g. 'visa-13-2').

tools.name: get_response_deadlines
tools.description: Response windows merchants have to fight a chargeback, per gateway (Stripe, PayPal, Braintree, Adyen, Shopify Payments) and per card network (Visa, Mastercard, Amex).

tools.name: request_chargeback_audit
tools.description: Submit a free ChargeGuard store audit: reviews the merchant's payment setup and dispute risk and emails a written report. Requires the store URL and a contact email.
